name: Netatmo Weather
description: Live readings from a Netatmo Weather Station — room temperature, CO2, humidity, outdoor conditions, rain and wind — one module per board row.
author: Oliver Rummeyer

env_vars.name: NETATMO_CLIENT_ID
env_vars.description: Netatmo app client id (can also be set in the UI)

env_vars.name: NETATMO_CLIENT_SECRET
env_vars.description: Netatmo app client secret (can also be set in the UI)

env_vars.name: NETATMO_REFRESH_TOKEN
env_vars.description: Netatmo refresh token with the read_station scope (can also be set in the UI)

env_vars.name: NETATMO_TOKEN_STORE
env_vars.description: Where the rotated refresh token is cached. Defaults to netatmo_weather_tokens.json in FiestaBoard's data directory.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: From your app at dev.netatmo.com. See the setup guide.

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: From the same app at dev.netatmo.com.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Generated in the app's Token Generator with the read_station scope. Netatmo rotates it on every use; the plugin keeps the rotation to itself and never overwrites this field.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Which modules go on the board, in the order they should appear. Leave empty to show everything the station has.

module_names.title: Short module names
module_names.description: Optional board-sized name per module. A Flagship row is 22 tiles wide including the reading, so "Wohnzimmer Erdgeschoss" needs shortening.

units.title: Units
units.description: Netatmo always reports metric; imperial is converted by the plugin.

secondary.title: Second reading
secondary.description: Shown after the temperature, and dropped automatically when the row is too tight for it.

show_trend.title: Show temperature trend
show_trend.description: Adds + / - / = for Netatmo's rising, falling and stable trend. Dropped before the second reading when space runs out.

degree_sign.title: Degree sign
degree_sign.description: Tile 62 prints ° on a Flagship and a heart on a Note. Auto shows it only where it prints as a degree sign.

umlauts.title: Umlauts
umlauts.description: The board has no umlaut tiles. Expand writes KUECHE, Strip writes KUCHE.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone name used for the measurement time. Leave empty to follow the FiestaBoard-wide timezone.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh Interval
refresh_seconds.description: The station itself measures every five minutes, so anything below that only spends Netatmo's 500 calls per hour.

indoor_co2.description: Color the CO2 reading by air quality

module1_co2.description: Color the CO2 reading of module 1 by air quality

module1_temp.description: Color the temperature of module 1. No defaults — an indoor module and the one hanging outside want different thresholds, and the plugin cannot tell which is which.

module2_co2.description: Color the CO2 reading of module 2 by air quality

module2_temp.description: Color the temperature of module 2. No defaults — an indoor module and the one hanging outside want different thresholds, and the plugin cannot tell which is which.

module3_co2.description: Color the CO2 reading of module 3 by air quality

module3_temp.description: Color the temperature of module 3. No defaults — an indoor module and the one hanging outside want different thresholds, and the plugin cannot tell which is which.

module4_co2.description: Color the CO2 reading of module 4 by air quality

module4_temp.description: Color the temperature of module 4. No defaults — an indoor module and the one hanging outside want different thresholds, and the plugin cannot tell which is which.

module5_co2.description: Color the CO2 reading of module 5 by air quality

module5_temp.description: Color the temperature of module 5. No defaults — an indoor module and the one hanging outside want different thresholds, and the plugin cannot tell which is which.

module6_co2.description: Color the CO2 reading of module 6 by air quality

module6_temp.description: Color the temperature of module 6. No defaults — an indoor module and the one hanging outside want different thresholds, and the plugin cannot tell which is which.

station.description: Station name as Netatmo has it

updated.description: Local time of the most recent measurement (HH:MM)

module_count.description: How many modules the board layout is showing

temp_unit.description: Unit suffix for temperatures, board-aware (no degree sign on a Note)

indoor_name.description: Name of the indoor module the indoor variables come from

indoor_noise.description: Noise level in dB, measured by the main unit only

indoor_trend.description: Indoor temperature trend as + rising, - falling, = stable

pressure.description: Air pressure at sea level, in mbar or inHg

pressure_trend.description: Pressure trend as + rising, - falling, = stable

outdoor_min.description: Lowest outdoor temperature so far today

outdoor_max.description: Highest outdoor temperature so far today

outdoor_trend.description: Outdoor temperature trend as + rising, - falling, = stable

rain_hour.description: Rain in the last hour, in mm or inches

rain_today.description: Rain in the last 24 hours, in mm or inches

wind.description: Wind speed in km/h or mph

wind_gust.description: Strongest gust in km/h or mph

wind_from.description: Wind direction as an eight-point compass label

block.description: The whole laid-out board as one value, rows separated by newlines. Put this on the first template line to fill the board.

line1.description: Board row 1 of the module layout, padded to the board width

line2.description: Board row 2 of the module layout, padded to the board width

line3.description: Board row 3 of the module layout, padded to the board width

line4.description: Board row 4, empty on a Note

line5.description: Board row 5, empty on a Note

line6.description: Board row 6, empty on a Note

module1_name.description: Name of module 1 in your Modules order — the module on board row 1 of a Flagship

module1_temp.description: Temperature of module 1, no unit suffix

module1_humidity.description: Relative humidity of module 1 in percent

module1_co2.description: CO2 of module 1 in ppm, empty for modules without a CO2 sensor

module2_temp.description: Temperature of module 2, no unit suffix
